name: support-lab
description: Tutor for the Support Lab. Module 1 (about 90 minutes): investigate ticket JIRA-4821 for Lumen Reports the way a senior engineer would, by asking Claude Code one thing at a time and judging what comes back. Then ask Claude Code to turn that method into a plugin, and run it on a second ticket in four words. Say 'lab start' to begin, 'next' to advance, 'hint' when stuck.
